# Compact Fluentic API reference

## Messages

```ts
t.msg(source, schema?)                 // inert typed descriptor
t.text(sourceOrDescriptor, params?)    // current-language string
t.jsx(sourceOrDescriptor, params?)     // reactive React content
t.jsx(() => element)                   // fine-grained reactive element boundary
t.context(name)                        // identity scope
t.note(text)                           // translator guidance
t.meta(jsonValue)                      // structured extraction metadata
t.tag(handlerOrElement)                // rich-message tag handler
t.try(renderer, value, params?)        // render descriptors; return other values
t.clone(descriptor)                    // copy descriptor
t.params(params?)                      // same params or {}
t.notranslate(callback)                // source fallback with active-locale formatting
```

`t.msg`, `t.text`, and message-form `t.jsx` require static sources for extraction. Callback-form `t.jsx` is a boundary; its nested message calls are extracted.

## Manager

```ts
I18nManager.configure({ languageId, fallbackLanguageId? })
I18nManager.setStorage(adapterOrNull)
I18nManager.setTranslationLoader(loaderOrNull)
await I18nManager.init()
await I18nManager.setLanguageId(languageId)
I18nManager.getLanguageId()
I18nManager.getTranslation({ languageId?, context?, message })
```

Configure before `init()`. Initialize before mounting React. A failed switch retains the old active language.

## State

```ts
I18nState.get()                 // {languageId, isLoading, ready}
I18nState.use()                 // React whole-component subscription
I18nState.subscribe(listener)   // returns unsubscribe
```

## Loaders and browser cache

```ts
const loader = defineTranslationLoader({
  en: [],
  fr: () => import('./fr.jsonl?raw'),
});

const cache = createTranslationCacheLoader(loader, {
  hash: () => import('./hash.json'),
  storageKey: 'my-app:i18n',
});

I18nManager.setTranslationLoader(cache.loader);
cache.remove('fr');
cache.clear();
```

Cache controls affect persistent data. Replace the manager loader and initialize again to clear/reload in-memory catalogs.

## Isolated runtimes and hydration

```ts
const instance = createI18nManager(); // {manager, state, runtime}
```

Initialize and pass `instance` to `I18nProvider`. Custom SSR adapters import `getSnapshot` and `hydrate` from `@fluentic/i18n/hydration`. SPAs do not use hydration APIs. Next.js owns hydration internally.
